capabilities: Insert the codename at the cursor via the Codename: Insert Codename command
motivation: The author built it because naming is one of the hardest problems, and a quick generated codename lets you start linking things and rename later to something more relevant.
problem: Naming notes and projects is hard and can stall getting organized in Obsidian, especially before you know what you are building.
summary: Random codename generator that inserts a generated name at the cursor via a command palette command.
